note: Weekly token revenue on OpenRouter: each model's prompt and completion tokens times its effective (traffic-weighted, cache-inclusive) input and output price; ':free' variants earn nothing. 'full' weeks count every model from OpenRouter's daily per-model activity (31-day window); 'chart' weeks price the Top Models chart's named models the same way and the rest of each lab's tokens (weekly market-share chart) at that lab's measured rate for its smaller models. See engine/collect_token_revenue.py.
